question: The area of the triangle formed by $A(1,1)$, $B(5,3)$ and $C(k,6)$ is $5$ square units. Determine all possible values of $k$.
explanation:
Application of the area formula
The given condition gives $$\frac{1}{2}\left|\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\5&3&1\\k&6&1\end{vmatrix}\right|=5$$
Expansion of the determinant
The determinant equals $$1(3-6)-1(5-k)+(30-3k)$$
Formation of the modulus equation
Simplifying gives $$-3-5+k+30-3k=22-2k$$ Therefore, $$\frac{1}{2}|22-2k|=5$$ and hence $$|22-2k|=10$$
Solution of the two cases
Thus, $22-2k=10$ or $22-2k=-10$. These give $$k=6\quad\text{or}\quad k=16$$
